In detail

North Yorkshire Police recorded 47 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 1.9 per 1,000 residents, the 19th highest rate of York's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by drugs (1), vehicle crime (1), bicycle theft (0); the evening/night score by violent crime (7), anti social behaviour (4), public order (1). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Strensall safe?

Wandroz currently rates Strensall in York as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from North Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Strensall safe at night?

At night, Strensall is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Strensall's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
